source_description: Extend joyus-desktop's skill-sync infrastructure to manage the full local tooling lifecycle — not just skill files, but Claude Code hooks, MCP server entries, per-tenant policy-driven configuration, and immediate revocation. A new settings-reconciler package handles non-destructive merging of managed entries into settings.json / .mcp.json, using a joyus: prefix + sidecar registry for ownership tracking. Revocation uses a lightweight config-check poll on a fast interval, triggering a full sync only when the control plane flags a change. Settings target global scope by default with manifest-level project overrides. Rollback on failure leverages skill-sync's existing backup system.
